03d_frame_asset_plan.md:
# Frame Asset Plan — v3

Plan every critical still state before video generation. `deterministic` here means the approved output geometry/pixels are frozen by source/code/post contracts; the configured image generator itself remains generative.

| Frame ID | Used by shot/unit | Role | Build route | Source/reference IDs | Pixel lock | Risk | Autonomy | Candidate N | Exact KEEP | Allowed CHANGE | Composition / crop contract | Image task | Code/post task | Text policy | Output path | Approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Roles: `START / END / SEAM / BRIDGE / COMPOSITE / PLATE / POST_GRAPHIC`.

Build routes: `SOURCE_LOCKED / CODE_COMPOSITE / IMAGE25_EDIT / IMAGE25_SYNTH / HYBRID_IMAGE25_CODE / POST_GRAPHIC`.

Pixel lock levels:
- `P0_FREE`: fully generative visual state; no evidence-critical pixels.
- `P1_GEOMETRY_LOCK`: style/geometry reference only; factual details still independently verified.
- `P2_EVIDENCE_LOCK`: evidence-critical regions must be preserved; use masks/reference and verify.
- `P3_TEXT_IDENTITY_LOCK`: exact source pixels/text/faces/documents/signage must be re-overlaid by code/post after any generative step.

For `IMAGE25_*` rows, important Chinese text/dates/labels normally remain post-only.

05f_shot_endpoint_plan.md:
# Video Shot Endpoint Plan — v3

This file controls **single-shot** start/end conditioning for the configured video provider. Whole-film opening/ending stays in `05a_film_opening_ending.md`; inter-shot joins stay in `05h_join_contracts.md`.

| Unit | Parent shot | Flow mode | Final edit duration | Duration | Use in | Use out | Start frame source | Start frame ID | Start role | Join-in seam | End frame needed? | End frame source | End frame ID | End target state | Join-out seam | KEEP fixed | CHANGE | Motion path | Endpoint distance | Reachability | Risk | Autonomy | Candidate N | Bridge/reset | Carry-in | Carry-out | Extraction rule | Approval |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|

`Duration` is the video source duration. Use the shortest **currently supported** duration that safely contains `Final edit duration` plus only the handles actually needed. Do not default every unit to 10 seconds.

Video endpoint rules:
- `T2V`: start/end frames usually optional.
- `START_FRAME`: start frame required; end frame optional.
- `FRAMES`: both start and end frames required; prompt describes the path, not the pictures.
- `INGREDIENTS`: endpoints optional; Ingredients carry identity/appearance.
- `EXTEND`: continuation inherits the approved clip state; manual end frame usually optional.
- `OMNI_EDIT`: preserve the clip and define only the localized change.
- `SKIP_FLOW`: no generated endpoints required.

Join rule: when two adjacent units use `EXACT_SEAM`, the previous End frame ID and next Start frame ID should resolve to the same approved seam frame.

Carry frames are fallback generated-output handoff assets. In v2 they do not replace a predesigned seam frame when an exact junction can be built in advance.
05h_join_contracts.md:
# Shot Join Contracts — v3

Design every important cut before final generation. The objective is not to hide every cut; it is to make every cut intentional and directly assemblable.

| Join | From unit | To unit | Join type | Shared seam frame | Exit state | Entry state | Exit motion | Entry motion | Screen direction | Audio bridge | Handles | Reset/occluder | Post overlay at join | Fallback | Approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Join types: `EXACT_SEAM / FLOW_EXTEND / MATCH_CUT / OCCLUSION_RESET / GRAPHIC_RESET / HARD_CUT`.

Rules:
- `EXACT_SEAM`: both units share the same approved junction frame.
- `FLOW_EXTEND`: next unit continues from an approved clip state; preserve identity/geometry.
- `MATCH_CUT`: geometry/motion/theme is matched deliberately; pixel identity is not required.
- `OCCLUSION_RESET`: a doorway/paper edge/matte/full-frame occluder legally hides a world/era reset.
- `GRAPHIC_RESET`: map/title/document/flat graphic is the intentional reset surface.
- `HARD_CUT`: cut for narrative impact; do not fake a dissolve just to hide incompatibility.

Run `scripts/review_join_contracts.py` before final generated video.

# Generation Candidate Review

Review hero transitions by failure dimension, not by a single beauty score.

| Shot | Candidate | Route | Endpoint adherence | First 10% boundary | Last 10% boundary | Identity / geometry | Motion smoothness | Camera obedience | Prompt adherence | Artifacts / flicker | Cuttability / carry frame | Decision | Rejection reason | Change next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Reroll rule

If 2 distinct candidates fail on the same dimension, change the endpoint, route, bridge, reference allocation, or prompt. Do not keep sampling the same impossible constraints.
